RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the February  17, 2009/Magha 28, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
8
Satyam Computers Scam
*21. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of
CORPORATE AFF AIRS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any significant headway has
been made into the Satyam Computers
Scam;
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the extent of misappropriation of funds,
the period for which these irregularities have
been going on;
(c) the extent of involvement of auditors
and others in the Scam; and
(d) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to ensure to detect other cases of profit
boosting and other corporate frauds?
Establishment of museums at district
and regional level
*22. MS. MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to establish
more museums at district and regional levels
to take the museum movement to the people
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also proposed to
redefine the museum concept to keep pace
with the evolving social changes;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what are the details of districts/
regions where this new concept is proposed
to be implemented in Orissa and Jharkhand?
Transportation of oil from Caspian
region
*23. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE THAKUR:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the issue of transportation
of oil from Caspian region through the
Mediterranean and Red Sea into India was
discussed during the visit of Foreign
Minister of Turkey to India in February,
2008;

9
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the salient features of the
discussion;
(c) whether it is also a fact that oil, if
brought from Caspian region through the
Mediterranean and Red Sea, will be cheaper;
(d) if so, whether Government has taken
any decision on the issue; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Aviation scene in Bihar
*24. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the present status of expansion of
infrastructure facilities at Patna and Gaya
airports;
(b) how many more airports have been
planned for Bihar;
(c) the present status of their execution;
and
(d) whether Government would
consider expanding infrastructural facilities
and providing more air connectivity with
different countries of the world in view of
tourist influx in Gaya?
Competition among oil
companies
†*25. SHRIMATI  SUSHMA
SWARAJ: W ill the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NA TURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the decision
of reducing the prices of petrol and diesel
has been left on open market;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the open market pricing
policy would increase the competition
among various oil companies; and
(d) if so, the policy formulated to
regulate the competition among these oil
companies?
Problems faced  by corporate houses
*26. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of problems pointed out
and suggestions made by corporate houses
during the last two years and the current
year;
(b) the steps taken to solve these
problems;
(c) the details of problems solved and
those yet to be solved; and
(d) by when these problems would be
solved?
Exit facilities at Delhi Airport
†*27. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it has come to light that in
the recent past the passengers have had to
wait for a long time while coming out after
the arrival of  the flights at Delhi Airport;
(b) if so, whether any arrangement has
been made by all the airlines and other
agencies for maintaining time in carrying
out all works relating to various procedures,
i.e. reaching the bus at aircraft, receiving
cargo, hiring taxi etc.; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

10
Flaring of natural gas in
Assam
*28.  KUMAR DEEPAK DAS: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of natural gas being
flared out daily in Assam during the last
ten years and its total cost, according to
the  present price of natural gas; and
(b) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken by Government for use of natural
gas and feasibility of gas based industries
in Assam?
Demand of oil in India
*29. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:

AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to

certain degree by the year end;
(b) whether oil demand declined by 47
